accuracyChecks.method: 5 random items per chapter (90) plus 6 mock items (अपठित गद्यांश/काव्यांश, रचनात्मक लेखन choice, अभिव्यक्ति theory set, वितान set), re-solved by hand against the lesson facts; facts not certain (exact ages, collection names, numeric details) were removed before generation
fixes: removed giveaway extract MCQs ('गद्यांश/काव्यांश का भाव किस पाठ से जुड़ा है?') whose answer was printed in the extract heading (18 rows)
poem-writing task asked for '120 शब्दों में' a poem; changed to 'लगभग 8-12 पंक्तियों की एक छोटी कविता'
word limit for 2-mark questions in अभिव्यक्ति और माध्यम subtopics raised from 25-30 to 30-40 words (class 12 norm)
board-style internal choice (three topics, write on one) used for the 6-mark रचनात्मक लेखन / संस्मरण mock slot so mock stems never repeat bank stems
pre-generation removals: Bhaktin's age at widowhood and an अनुप्रास claim on 'जीर्ण बाहु, है शीर्ण शरीर' (not certain)
